public_facts.scene: Two upright red cups; blue, green and yellow blocks on table. Photograph each reset. Left/right from the resting arm looking forward.
public_facts.reset_requirement: Same marked cup and block locations within the setup for each matched model trial; arm at rest. Operator records a distinct reset ID.
public_facts.camera_notes: Wrist camera rotates with wrist roll. Side camera is oblique, not overhead. Use wrist for XY alignment and side for height.
